say: Most small shops in Africa run on a phone and a paper book, or on no records at all.
caption: Most small shops in Africa run on a phone and a paper book, or on no records at all.

say: E molly AI turns what the owner says into real books. For this hackathon, we rebuilt its agent on NVIDIA Nemotron models, served by Nebius Token Factory.
caption: Imali AI turns what the owner says into real books. For this hackathon, we rebuilt its agent on NVIDIA Nemotron models, served by Nebius Token Factory.

say: Rudo runs a corner shop. She types: sold three bread and two cooking oil, cash.
caption: Rudo runs a corner shop. She types: sold three bread and two cooking oil, cash.

say: Nemotron 3 Nano reads it and calls a typed tool. Our ledger, plain tested code, builds the double entry from her price list.
caption: Nemotron 3 Nano reads it and calls a typed tool. Our ledger, plain tested code, builds the double entry from her price list.

say: Nothing goes into the books until she taps Record.
caption: Nothing goes into the books until she taps Record.

say: She can write the way she speaks. In chiShona: a tray of eggs and two milks, paid by mobile money. Nano knows that mazai is eggs, and mukaka is milk.
caption: She can write the way she speaks. In chiShona: a tray of eggs and two milks, paid by mobile money. Nano knows that mazai is eggs, and mukaka is milk.

say: Mai Tendai takes sugar and maize meal on credit. It lands on her tab, and the agent warns that maize meal is running low.
caption: Mai Tendai takes sugar and maize meal on credit. It lands on her tab, and the agent warns that maize meal is running low.

say: A delivery arrives, and Rudo photographs the invoice.
caption: A delivery arrives, and Rudo photographs the invoice.

say: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads every line. Nano matches the lines to her stock, flags that sugar cost more this time, and asks her price for the new peanut butter.
caption: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads every line. Nano matches the lines to her stock, flags that sugar cost more this time, and asks her price for the new peanut butter.

say: A customer pays sixty ZiG on mobile money. Tavily search finds today's official rate, Nano reads it with its source, and the ledger converts the sale to dollars.
caption: A customer pays 60 ZiG on mobile money. Tavily search finds today's official rate, Nano reads it with its source, and the ledger converts the sale to dollars.

say: Two costs in one line become two records. Baba Farai pays back his four dollars.
caption: Two costs in one line become two records. Baba Farai pays back his four dollars.

say: What should I restock before the weekend? That needs thought, so Nano passes it to Nemotron 3 Super, with the whole book and a week of sales.
caption: What should I restock before the weekend? That needs thought, so Nano passes it to Nemotron 3 Super, with the whole book and a week of sales.

say: At closing, Rudo counts forty-seven dollars thirty. Code works out that the till should hold forty-nine thirty.
caption: At closing, Rudo counts $47.30. Code works out that the till should hold $49.30.

say: Nemotron 3 Ultra reads the day's records, names the likeliest reasons for the two-dollar gap, and writes tomorrow's reorder list.
caption: Nemotron 3 Ultra reads the day's records, names the likeliest reasons for the $2 gap, and writes tomorrow's reorder list.

say: Every step shows which Nemotron model ran, how long it took, and what it cost on Token Factory. The big models run only where they earn their price.
caption: Every step shows which Nemotron model ran, how long it took, and what it cost on Token Factory. The big models run only where they earn their price.
